text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Why does it feel like someone was
calling me
just now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if whoever called me is
hungry...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Helloooo? I can make you some chanko,
so come
out, come out, wherever you
are!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's the Three Goddesses. Hehe.
Would you
like to join me for some
chan—
